description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the Operations class in the org.eclipse.example.calc package, testing registration, retrieval, size, and naming of operations such as Plus, Minus, Equals, and Square.

classes.name: OperationsTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the Operations class functionality in the calculator package.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating instances of operations and a Square object before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets the Operations singleton after each test.

methods.name: testRegister
methods.description: Tests that registering an operation (Square) is successful and that double registration fails.

methods.name: testGetOperation
methods.description: Verifies that the correct operation instances are returned for specific symbols.

methods.name: testSize
methods.description: Checks that the total number of registered operations is as expected (4).

methods.name: testGetOperationName
methods.description: Ensures that operation names and their corresponding operation objects are consistent.
